title: What 11 Days Without Sleep Does to Your Body 😵
description: In 1964, 17-year-old Randy Gardner stayed awake for 11 days and 25 minutes. Here's what happened to his brain and body. #shorts #science #sleep #humanbody #facts

scenes.narration: In 1964, a seventeen year old stayed awake for eleven days straight. Here's what happened to his body.
After just twenty four hours, your reactions are as impaired as someone over the legal drinking limit.
Then your brain starts forcing microsleeps, switching off for seconds without you even noticing.
Your immune system weakens, and germs you would normally crush start winning.
By day four, he was hallucinating. He thought a street sign was a person.
When he finally slept, he crashed for fourteen hours, and his brain recovered.
Guinness stopped tracking this record because it's too dangerous. Would you last three days?
